$comment: Sandbox images pinned by digest (09 4.4). Written by .github/workflows/images.yml through scripts/images.py lock: every docker/<dir>/Dockerfile is built for linux/amd64, scanned (Trivy Critical blocks), pushed to private ghcr.io/soken-ltd/<dir>; entries match by repository, so aliases get the same digest. Runtime pulls repository@digest only (sandbox.profile.locked_image). A zero digest = not built yet: callers fail closed.
